title: On the Rate of Convergence of GD in Non-linear Neural Networks: An Adversarial Robustness Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2603.02095v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the convergence dynamics of Gradient Descent (GD) in a minimal binary classification setting, consisting of a two-neuron ReLU network and two training instances. We prove that even under these strong simplifying assumptions, while GD successfully converges to an optimal robustness margin, effectively maximizing the distance between the decision boundary and the training points, this convergence occurs at a prohibitively slow rate, scaling strictly as $\Theta(1/\ln(t))$. To the best of our knowledge, this establishes the first explicit lower bound on the convergence rate of the robustness margin in a non-linear model. Through empirical simulations, we further demonstrate that this inherent failure mode is pervasive, exhibiting the exact same tight convergence rate across multiple natural network initializations. Our theoretical guarantees are derived via a rigorous analysis of the GD trajectories across the distinct act

translated_title: 关于非线性神经网络中梯度下降收敛速度的研究：对抗鲁棒性视角
translated_abstract: 我们在一个极简的二分类设置中研究梯度下降（GD）的收敛动态，该设置由一个双神经元ReLU网络和两个训练样本组成。我们证明，即使在这些强简化假设下，虽然GD能够成功收敛到最优鲁棒性边际，有效地最大化决策边界与训练点之间的距离，但这一收敛以极其缓慢的速率发生，严格以 Θ(1/ln(t)) 的速度缩放。据我们所知，这建立了非线性模型中鲁棒性边际收敛速度的首个显式下界。通过经验模拟，我们进一步证明这种固有的失效模式是普遍存在的，在多个自然网络初始化下均表现出完全相同的紧致收敛速率。我们的理论保证是通过对GD在不同激活机制下轨迹的严格分析得出的。
tldr: 该论文在双神经元ReLU网络的最简二分类设置中证明，梯度下降虽能收敛到最优对抗鲁棒性边际，但收敛速度极慢（严格为 Θ(1/ln(t))），并首次建立了非线性模型中鲁棒性边际收敛速度的显式下界。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that even in a minimal two-neuron ReLU network binary classification setting, Gradient Descent converges to the optimal adversarial robustness margin but at a prohibitively slow rate of Θ(1/ln(t)), establishing the first explicit lower bound on the convergence rate of the robustness margin in non-linear models.
